stories.headline: China's exports likely grew by double-digits in September
stories.body: The country's customs agency is due to release September trade data on Wednesday.

stories.headline: BofA gets $1.21B penalty for money laundering
stories.body: The Treasury Department and Office of the Comptroller of the Currency Tuesday announced that they had found the bank had processed over $5 billion in unreported suspicious transactions and committed hundreds of sanctions violations.
